main.description: Lists indexed rights records with an optional publisher-DID filter. Authentication is not required.

authors.description: Publisher DIDs; repeat the unbracketed key for multiple authors. Values use OR.

sortDirection.description: Direction for the (createdAt, uri) order; defaults to desc.

limit.description: Maximum records in the page; defaults to 25.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a previous page; keep the sort direction unchanged.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: An author, sort direction, page bound, cursor, repeated scalar, or query parameter is invalid.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page; omitted when there is no next page.
